mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.post_id, r.review_title, r.review_content, p.post_date AS review_date, r.review_count, r.review_like_count FROM community_post_review r JOIN post p ON r.post_id = p.post_id WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId}
SELECT review_id FROM community_post_review WHERE post_id = #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET post_title = #{post_title}, post_content = #{post_content}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_id = #{targetId} WHERE post_id = #{post_id}
UPDATE community_post_review SET review_count = review_count + 1 WHERE review_id = #{review_id}
UPDATE community_post_review SET review_like_count = review_like_count + 1 WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
